$comment: Structured output for the upstream-sync agents (claude -p --json-schema, codex exec --output-schema). Strict: every property required, no extra keys; use [] or "" when a field does not apply.

status.description: triage: ok | nothing_relevant | needs_judgment. resolve: resolved | needs_judgment. needs_judgment means the merge itself cannot be done safely by a script (not a product decision: those go in decisions).

decisions.description: Upstream changes the job must NOT ship without the user: held back, everything else ships.

id.description: short kebab-case key, stable across weeks

holdBy.description: revert: git revert the listed upstream commits after the merge. keep_ours: the resolve agent keeps our behaviour with the smallest pin.
